harnessTools.resultIdFormat: <4 hex run tag>-<n>, shown as the first line "result_id: <id>" of every scenario tool result and every successful calculate result

tools.description: Compute over results you already obtained in this task; it fetches nothing. Every tool result starts with a line result_id: <id>. Name one or more results in sources, each with an optional path to the part to use, and one generic operation. The records are the elements found at the paths of all sources, one after the other. count: the number of records. distinct: the distinct values of field. group_by: groups by the fields in group_by, with aggregate count or sum of sum_field. sort: the records ordered by field (descending optional). filter: the records for which every condition holds (eq, ne, lt, le, gt, ge against a literal value). union, intersection, difference: set operations on the values of field taken per source (difference: the first source minus the others). arithmetic: operator add, subtract, multiply or divide over operands, each a number or {result_id, path} naming one number. fields and limit shorten a list of records; round sets decimal places. A field is a dot-separated path inside a record; empty means the record itself. The result has a result_id of its own.

path.description: Optional. Dot-separated keys or list positions into that result; * takes every element of a list. A text that holds JSON or XML is read as such. Empty means the whole result.

result_id.description: The id from the first line of an earlier result of this task.

voidRule.excludedWindow: a category D task's own stopped service, from its stop until its restore
voidRule.onVoid: stop with status block_void; the resume repeats the block whole as the next attempt
voidRule.spend: the void attempt stays in the vendor ledgers and is reported apart in bundle.json (voidAttempts)

triggers.health: the health check finds a backend down, or cannot be read, at the block start, every health_every_runs runs or at the block end
triggers.provenance: the provenance observation at the block start finds a declared backend down (no container, or not running)
triggers.restore: after a category D task, the restored service, the MCP server or any backend does not answer again within the scenario's ready_timeout_seconds
